recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not edit retired BodySite source for this DSTU2 issue; future anatomical-location modeling work should be handled under current BodyStructure issues.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO change request for DSTU2 BodySite asking to rename BodySite.modifier to BodySite.qualifier because laterality and relative-location details qualify/refine the anatomical location rather than acting as FHIR modifier elements.
initial_application: Git commit 29f4601440af8375fc9f1e19f0d38727cd29aec4 applied the historical BodySite source rename, changing BodySite.modifier to BodySite.qualifier, BodySiteModifier to BodySiteQualifier, and Modifier wording to Qualifier wording in the BodySite spreadsheet source.
additional_context: BodySite is no longer active in the current build: source/fhir.ini activates bodystructure=BodyStructure, lists BodySite under removed resources, notes that BodySite became BodyStructure, and retains BodySite.modifier=BodySite.qualifier only as an old-to-new conversion map. FHIR-13396 later renamed BodySite to BodyStructure, and the active BodyStructure definition now contains BodyStructure.includedStructure.qualifier.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested rename is already represented in historical source, the current conversion map, and the active BodyStructure qualifier element.

related_jiras.note: Renamed BodySite to BodyStructure, explaining why the current active resource path is BodyStructure rather than BodySite.
